selection.edition: international SurveyMonkey API v3 US (Composio SURVEY_MONKEY HTTP tools)
selection.ownership: SurveyMonkey Inc., San Mateo, California, United States (acquired by Symphony Technology Group in 2023 after the Momentive period). The reviewed edition is the public international REST API v3 at api.surveymonkey.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official SurveyMonkey API v3 (private-app long-lived access token as Authorization Bearer, GET /v3/users/me, GET /v3/surveys, GET /v3/surveys/{id}/details, GET /v3/surveys/{id}/collectors, GET /v3/contact_lists, US host api.surveymonkey.com), Help Center API article, Trust Centre, San Mateo identity, and dated incident search for SurveyMonkey / Momentive security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Third-party phishing that hosts a lure on a SurveyMonkey survey is not a SurveyMonkey API or backend compromise. No qualifying current unresolved customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official SurveyMonkey v3 private-app Bearer access token, US host api.surveymonkey.com, and GET users/surveys/collectors/contact_lists reviewed on 2026-09-13. Operator is SurveyMonkey Inc., San Mateo. Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved compromise. Survey phishing lures are third-party misuse.

incidents.summary: Joe Sandbox reported a phishing chain that used a SurveyMonkey survey page as a lure before redirecting to an attacker-controlled Microsoft login. That is third-party misuse of a public survey, not a disclosed SurveyMonkey API or backend compromise.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v3/users/me used by the pinned validator.
Private-app long-lived access tokens are the documented Bearer path; OAuth2 authorization-code is not implemented.

EU (api.eu.surveymonkey.com) and Canada (api.surveymonkey.ca) hosts are not expressed: the source maps a stored optional origin onto three hostnames, and the US value is api.surveymonkey.com, so a bounded wildcard plus required stored id cannot represent the mapping. The native template pins api.surveymonkey.com, matching the pinned executor.

collectors.list.description: List collectors and distribution URLs for a SurveyMonkey survey via GET /v3/surveys/{surveyId}/collectors. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_COLLECTORS.

name.description: Partial match filter on collector name.

include.description: Additional fields to include per collector: type, status, response_count, date_created, date_modified, url.

startDate.description: Filter collectors created after this datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

endDate.description: Filter collectors created before this datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

collectors.list.title: List collectors

contact-lists.list.description: List contact lists in the connected SurveyMonkey account via GET /v3/contact_lists. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_LIST_CONTACT_LISTS.
contact-lists.list.title: List contact lists

healthcheck.description: Validate the SurveyMonkey access token with GET /v3/users/me. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_CURRENT_USER.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

surveys.get.description: Get expanded survey details including pages, questions, and answer choices via GET /v3/surveys/{surveyId}/details. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_SURVEY_DETAILS2.
surveys.get.title: Get survey details

surveys.list.description: List surveys available to the connected SurveyMonkey account via GET /v3/surveys. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_SURVEYS.

include.description: Additional fields to include per survey, or filters: response_count, date_modified, date_created, question_count, page_count, category, language, folder_id, shared_with, shared_by, owned, analyze_url, preview.

surveys.list.title: List surveys

benchmark-bundles.list.description: List SurveyMonkey benchmark bundles via GET /v3/benchmark_bundles. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_LIST_BENCHMARK_BUNDLES.

page.description: Page of resources to return. Defaults to 1.

country.description: Country code to filter benchmark bundles. Default is US.

benchmark-bundles.list.title: List benchmark bundles

contact-fields.list.description: List custom contact fields via GET /v3/contact_fields. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_LIST_CONTACT_FIELDS.

page.description: Page of resources to return. Defaults to 1.

contact-fields.list.title: List contact fields

contact-lists.create.description: Create a SurveyMonkey contact list via POST /v3/contact_lists. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_CREATE_CONTACT_LIST. Name defaults to New List when omitted.

name.description: Name of the contact list to create.

contact-lists.create.title: Create contact list

contacts.bulk.create.description: Create multiple contacts via POST /v3/contacts/bulk. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_CREATE_BULK_CONTACTS. Requires contacts_write.

contacts.description: Contact objects to create. Each contact should include first_name, last_name, and either email or phone_number.

items.description: One SurveyMonkey contact. Official API requires first_name, last_name, and either email or phone_number.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field ID (for example '1', '2').

update_existing.description: Whether to update existing contacts with the same email or phone number. Defaults to false.

contacts.bulk.create.title: Create bulk contacts

contacts.bulk.list.description: Retrieve contacts with all available fields via GET /v3/contacts/bulk. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_BULK_CONTACTS.

page.description: Page of resources to return. Defaults to 1.

contacts.bulk.list.title: Bulk get contacts

contacts.create.description: Create a SurveyMonkey contact via POST /v3/contacts. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_CREATE_CONTACT. Contacts can be used for email invitations.

email.description: Contact email address. Primary identifier for the contact.

phone_number.description: Contact phone number. Official API requires email or phone_number.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field ID (for example '1', '2').

contacts.create.title: Create contact

contacts.list.description: List, filter, and search contacts via GET /v3/contacts. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_CONTACTS. Requires contacts_read or contacts_write.

page.description: Page of resources to return. Defaults to 1.

status.description: Filter contacts by status. Defaults to active.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by. Options: email (default), first_name, last_name, or custom fields 1 through 6.

search.description: Search query string to filter contacts.

search_by.description: Field to search in. Options: email, first_name, last_name, or custom fields 1 through 6.

contacts.list.title: Get contacts

groups.list.description: List SurveyMonkey groups (teams) via GET /v3/groups. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_GROUPS.

page.description: Page of resources to return. Defaults to 1.

include.description: Comma-separated additional fields to include in each group object, for example member_count.

groups.list.title: Get groups

responses.bulk.list.description: Retrieve bulk survey responses with full question answers via GET /v3/surveys/{id}/responses/bulk. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_SURVEY_RESPONSES_BULK. Requires responses_read_detail.

id.description: Survey ID to fetch bulk responses for.

start_created_at.description: Filter responses created after this datetime (ISO 8601).

end_created_at.description: Filter responses created before this datetime (ISO 8601).

responses.bulk.list.title: Get survey responses (bulk)

responses.list.description: List response metadata for a survey via GET /v3/surveys/{survey_id}/responses. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_RESPONSES. Iterate pages to avoid missing responses.

survey_id.description: The unique identifier of the survey.

page.description: Page number to return. Defaults to 1.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by. Official API accepts date_modified.

start_created_at.description: Filter responses created after this datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

end_created_at.description: Filter responses created before this datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

start_modified_at.description: Filter responses modified after this datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

end_modified_at.description: Filter responses modified before this datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

first_name.description: Filter responses by recipient first name.

last_name.description: Filter responses by recipient last name.

custom.description: Filter responses by custom value associated with the response.

custom_variables.description: Filter responses by custom variables as key:value pairs.

total_time_min.description: Filter responses with total time greater than or equal to this value.

total_time_max.description: Filter responses with total time less than or equal to this value.

responses.list.title: Get survey responses

survey-folders.create.description: Create a survey folder via POST /v3/survey_folders. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_CREATE_SURVEY_FOLDER.

title.description: Title of the survey folder used to organize surveys.

survey-folders.create.title: Create survey folder

survey-languages.list.description: List languages available for multilingual surveys via GET /v3/survey_languages. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_LIST_AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES.

page.description: Page of resources to return. Defaults to 1.

survey-languages.list.title: List available languages

surveys.create.description: Create an empty SurveyMonkey survey with one empty page via POST /v3/surveys. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_CREATE_SURVEY. Shareable collector URLs are not returned; use collectors.list after creation.

title.description: Title of the new survey. Displayed to respondents.

nickname.description: Optional internal nickname (not shown to respondents).

language.description: Survey language code in ISO 639-1 format. Defaults to en.

footer.description: Whether to display SurveyMonkey branding footer. Defaults to true.

surveys.create.title: Create survey

surveys.delete.description: Delete a survey via DELETE /v3/surveys/{survey_id}. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_DELETE_SURVEY. Deletion is irreversible.

survey_id.description: The unique identifier of the survey to delete.

surveys.delete.title: Delete survey

surveys.get_summary.description: Get survey metadata via GET /v3/surveys/{survey_id} (not the expanded /details payload). Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_SURVEY_DETAILS. Use surveys.get for pages, questions, and answer options.

survey_id.description: The unique identifier of the survey to fetch details for.

surveys.get_summary.title: Get survey details

surveys.trends.get.description: Get trend data for a survey via GET /v3/surveys/{survey_id}/trends. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_GET_SURVEY_TRENDS. Not available for file_upload, slider, presentation, demographic, matrix_menu, or datetime questions.

survey_id.description: The unique identifier of the survey to get trends for.

trend_by.description: Time period grouping for trend data (day, week, or month).

start_created_at.description: Filter responses by creation date start (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

end_created_at.description: Filter responses by creation date end (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

start_modified_at.description: Filter responses by modified date start (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

end_modified_at.description: Filter responses by modified date end (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

surveys.trends.get.title: Get survey trends

webhooks.list.description: List configured SurveyMonkey webhooks via GET /v3/webhooks. Maps to SURVEY_MONKEY_LIST_WEBHOOKS. This is an outbound webhook catalog, not an inbound trigger.

page.description: Page of resources to return. Defaults to 1.

webhooks.list.title: List webhooks
